title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Tagaru Palya
desc: After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.

title: Advocate
desc: Three girls who escape molestation but are charged with murder must prove their innocence with the help of a lawyer who is an alcoholic.

title: James
desc: The life of Santhosh changes after Vijay, owner of a crime organisation called Gayakwad Syndicate, enlists his help in his business dealings.
